name: @lacspace/sensitivity
description: Zero-AI first pass for a newsroom's sensitive-story gate, in Nepali and English. classify({ title, text, lang }) returns categories (election, court, death, communal, named_individual, minor, health_emergency), a confidence (certain → skip the model, unsure → ask it) and the matched terms. Bilingual lexicons with suffix-aware Devanagari matching, false-friend exclusions (death overs, climate justice, मुद्दा as 'issue', 'N वर्षका लागि'), headline/lead weighting that ignores scraped sidebar noise, harm context for minors, a person check for allegations, and policy-ruling detection for courts. On 200 real newsroom stories it settled 76% without the model. Zero-dependency.
author: Lacspace <contact@lacspace.com>
